structural_findings: These records are not self-palindromes: forward reading != reverse reading.
Both directions occupy the same 31-kana mirror space and can be segmented as 5/7/5/7/7 in the clear cases.
They therefore supply historical evidence for asymmetric lexical and syntactic resegmentation under exact character reversal.
This layer is useful as contrastive evidence for seam grammar but must not be counted as strict palindrome positives.
safety_rules: Do not label bidirectional distinct-reverse poems as strict palindromes.
Do not use unresolved 123/130 readings to complete symmetry.
Do not change fixed50/wave2/wave3 strict counts.
Any future seam extraction must retain forward/reverse provenance separately.
